summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with an English translation of the Notice of Convocation of its 122nd Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and related materials. This is a routine administrative filing required for foreign private issuers to provide meeting notices and proxy materials to U.S. investors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. The filing solely concerns the annual shareholder meeting process without any extraordinary corporate action, making it a routine filing rather than a special situation.
